title: Evidence vault
subtitle: Proof that backs your career claims
newSubtitle: Add proof that backs a career claim

gate.locked: Career tools are not included in your plan
gate.off: The Evidence vault is switched off
gate.offBody: Your career profile and drafts are unchanged.

list.intro: Projects, credentials and work samples that back your career claims. Labels show only what has been established: a photo of a certificate is evidence attached, not issuer verified.
list.loadError: Could not load your evidence. Try again.
list.emptyBody: Add projects, certifications, or work samples to support your profile facts.
list.itemHint: Opens the item to edit it or manage its file
list.linkedFacts: {count, plural, one {Supports # profile fact} other {Supports # profile facts}}

item.loadError: Could not load this evidence item.
item.labelsNote: Labels change only when something is established, never by editing.
item.attachAfterSave: You can attach a file once the item is saved.

form.title: Title *
form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. AWS Solutions Architect or Open Source Compiler
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Brief summary of the work, credential, or reference
form.ownershipPlaceholder: e.g. Sole author, Lead designer, or 30% contributor

validation.webLink: Use a link that starts with https:// or http://.

file.title: Private file
file.linkNote: Opening uses a private link that works for five minutes.
file.hint: Attach a PDF, Word (.docx), PNG or JPEG file up to 10 MB, such as a certificate scan. Files are private: only you can open them, and storing one does not use a document credit.

alerts.deleteBody: It is removed from your vault and from any portfolio page that shows it. A stored file is deleted too.
alerts.deleteFailed: The evidence item was not deleted. Try again.
alerts.saveFirstBody: Save or undo your changes to this item, then manage its file.
alerts.photosBody: Allow photo library access in Settings to attach a photo of your certificate or work.
alerts.openFailedBody: The link could not be opened on this device. Try again.
alerts.removeFileBody: The stored file is deleted. The evidence item stays.

errors.tooLarge: That file is larger than the upload limit (10 MB).
errors.wrongType: Choose a PNG or JPEG photo.
errors.wrongFileType: Choose a PDF, Word (.docx), PNG or JPEG file.
errors.fileType: Use a PDF, PNG, JPEG, or DOCX file. The file must really be that type.
errors.storageFull: Your plan’s storage is full. Remove a file to add another.
errors.storageUnavailable: File storage is not available right now. Nothing was charged.
errors.fileFailed: The file action did not finish. Try again.
errors.capacity: Your career plan has no room for another evidence item.
errors.switchedOff: The Evidence vault is switched off right now.
errors.validation: Please check the fields for errors.
errors.saveFailed: The evidence item was not saved. Try again.
errors.notFound: This evidence item no longer exists.

labelLimits.self_reported: Your own statement. Nothing has been checked.
labelLimits.evidence_attached: A file or link is attached. It has not been checked with the issuer.
labelLimits.assessment_completed: A named assessment was passed. It covers only what that assessment measured.
labelLimits.issuer_verified: Checked with the issuer on the date shown, for the scope shown. It lapses when it expires or is revoked.
labelLimits.reference_confirmed: A reference confirmed this specific claim only, not your whole profile.

history.title: {count, plural, one {Verification history (# check)} other {Verification history (# checks)}}
history.readOnly: Checks are recorded by FlacronCV with your permission. They cannot be changed in the app.

redaction.confidential: Contains confidential employer or client material
redaction.help: Before this is shared, remove or blur names, figures and anything your employer or client has not allowed you to show.
redaction.confirm: I have removed confidential material and may share the rest
redaction.required: Confirm the redaction before sharing a confidential item.
redaction.confirmBody: "{title}" is marked confidential. Your note: {note}. Confirm you removed what your employer or client has not allowed you to show.

facts.title: Profile facts this supports
facts.hint: Link the confirmed facts this item is proof of.
facts.loadFailed: Your profile facts could not be loaded. The item can still be saved.
facts.empty: No confirmed profile facts yet. Confirm facts in your career profile to link them here.
facts.invalid: One of the linked profile facts no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
